messages:
Priya M: Quick Q — we've got a strong IC ready for promotion to L4. What's the deadline to submit the promo packet to hit an effective date of 2026-04-01? Need comp change in payroll same day too? @Nina (People Ops) @Dan (People Ops)
Nina (People Ops): Hey @Priya M — for an April 1 effective date submit everything by 2026-03-20 EOD PT. That includes manager recommendation, updated role profile, and proposed comp. Payroll changes are processed the night before the effective date but approvals must be in by the deadline.
Priya M: Got it — is there any circumstance we can retro a raise back to hire date? Manager asked.
Nina (People Ops): Retro pay can be applied but only back to the approved promotion effective date by default. Retro to hire date is only allowed with an exec exception and frankly rare. If you need that, open an exceptions ticket and mark it "exec-approve" and include strong rationale.
Dan (People Ops): Putting the short checklist here so it's easy to copy: 1) Manager fills promo form (link in internal doc) 2) Attach role profile + evidence 3) Add proposed new base and on-target comp 4) Manager 2-up sign-off 5) Calibration slot + calibration decision 6) People Ops review 7) Enter final amounts into payroll spreadsheet. Link: https://go.redwood/promo-process :link:
Sam L (Finance): FYI from finance — any retro pay > 30 days requires finance sign-off and will hit payroll on the next available cycle after approval. Also include comp band justification (where they sit in band).
Priya M: If comp band prevents a bump to market, can we do a spot bonus or one-time adjustment instead?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, spot bonus is an option if the role is band-constrained but manager + finance must approve the bonus amount and budget owner must sign off. Use the "comp-change" code in the payroll sheet.
Priya M: Can you paste the minimal front-line promo form fields I should include so I don't miss anything?
Nina (People Ops): Sure — paste this into the ticket: ```role: Senior Engineer
effective_date: 2026-04-01
proposed_base: 155000
proposed_on_target: 180000
justification_short: promoted to L4, owns infra project X and mentored 2 hires
manager_2up: Name
calibration_slot_requested: yes
notes: any salary discussions with candidate pre-hire or negotiated increases
```
comp-bot: Promotion packet received for Priya M's candidate — packet status: 1/5 forms received, calibration flag set. Calibration meeting auto-scheduled for 2026-03-22 09:00 PT.
Priya M: Nice, thanks. One more: IC -> Manager transitions — do they require a separate calibration or different approvals?
Nina (People Ops): IC->Manager transitions always require cross-functional calibration and a 2-up manager sign-off; expect an extra week for review. If you want the same April 1 effective date, submit by 2026-03-15 to allow time.
Dan (People Ops): Addendum: for new hires with pre-negotiated comp above band, include offer email thread in the packet and tag for "comp-exception" so execs see it during calibration.
Priya M: I'll submit the packet today and tag you both. Thanks! :thumbsup:
